question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class agent-scoped web/tool credential contract here, and should it live under `agents.list[].tools.web` or a generic per-agent plugin/tool configuration surface?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but the config location and precedence define a credential isolation boundary across SecretRef, plugin-owned webSearch settings, validation, docs, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Design Generic Agent-Scoped Tool/Plugin Config
options.body: Define one precedence and SecretRef contract for web tools plus plugin-owned webSearch settings before implementation.

options.title: Add Only `agents.list[].tools.web`
options.body: This is narrower and faster, but risks creating a second credential source that competes with plugin-owned webSearch config.

options.title: Keep Web Credentials Global
options.body: This keeps config lean but leaves billing, rate-limit, and credential isolation unsolved for multi-agent installs.

recommendation.title: Design Generic Agent-Scoped Tool/Plugin Config
recommendation.body: Define one precedence and SecretRef contract for web tools plus plugin-owned webSearch settings before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses config, SecretRef, and web-search provider boundaries where source history points most strongly to this owner.
